start.name: Village Square
start.description: A bustling square with cobblestone paths, surrounded by old stone buildings and a suspicious potion puddle.

alchemist_shop.name: Alchemist Shop
alchemist_shop.description: A cozy, bubbling workshop smelling of sulfur, glowing herbs, and explosive trial potions.

library.name: Ancient Library
library.description: Dusty bookshelves stretch to the ceiling, filled with ancient combat manuals and coffee-stained scrolls.

training_grounds.name: Training Grounds
training_grounds.description: A muddy yard filled with wooden dummies, targets full of arrows, and discarded practice weapons.

shop.name: General Store
shop.description: A cluttered shop filled with oddities, heavy armor, and sharp iron weapons.

forest_edge.name: Forest Edge
forest_edge.description: The trees start to thicken here. Strange giggling noises echo from deeper in the woods.

hidden_grove.name: Hidden Grove
hidden_grove.description: A quiet, misty grove where rare medicinal plants glow under the moonlight.

deep_forest.name: Deep Forest
deep_forest.description: The woods are dark and full of shadows. You feel like several pairs of eyes are judging your outfit.

cave_entrance.name: Cave Entrance
cave_entrance.description: A gaping dark hole in the rock face emitting scorched heat and dragon snorts.

boss_lair.name: Boss Lair
boss_lair.description: A vast cavern filled with charred bones, shiny gold coins, and an extremely grumpy dragon.

guard.name: Village Guard
guard.description: A stern-looking guard leaning heavily on a spear.
dialogue: I used to be an adventurer like you, but then I realized guard duty has a dental plan.
Stand clear! I am guarding this cobblestone with my life. It is very special cobblestone.
If you bring me that Healing Herb from the Hidden Grove, I'll reward you with a Petite Health Potion!

alchemist.name: Mad Alchemist
alchemist.description: A eccentric brewer wearing singed goggles and mixing glowing liquids.
dialogue: Welcome to my lab! Drink the green potion for health, and the red potion for attack power! Don't mix them unless you want extra arms.
Petite Potions (PM) are great for quick boosts, but Grand Potions (GM) pack a real punch!
No refunds if a potion turns your eyebrows blue for three weeks.

merchant.name: Shop Keeper
merchant.description: A friendly but suspiciously wealthy merchant.
dialogue: Welcome! Buy something or please stop breathing on my shiny weapons.
Need weapons? Grab an Iron Sword or a Grand Attack Potion (GM) before venturing out!
I accept gold, silver, or juicy gossip about the Mayor.

mayor.name: Village Mayor
mayor.description: The pompous mayor wearing a sash that is slightly too tight.
dialogue: As Mayor, I decree that someone else should go into the dangerous cave and save us!
My campaign promise was zero dragon attacks. Technically the dragon stays in its cave, so I am winning!
Retrieve my Magic Amulet from the Cave Dragon and I shall award you official Village Medals of Honor!

scholar.name: Royal Scholar
scholar.description: An old wizard in thick spectacles surrounded by piles of books.
dialogue: Knowledge is power! Have you read 'Dagger Techniques' or 'Mastering the Blade' yet?
If you can bring me the Dragon Horn from the Boss Lair, I will teach you secret weapon techniques!

veteran.name: Master at Arms
veteran.description: A scarred warrior demonstrating sword maneuvers.
dialogue: A dagger in the dark is worth two swords in the scabbard!
Always drink an Attack Potion before charging into a dragon's lair kid!

person.name: Tipsy Bard
person.description: A local bard slumping near the alchemist's brewing vats.
dialogue: *Hic* I drank an Attack Potion (PM) thinking it was apple juice, and now I punched a wooden fence down!
Did you know if you chug a Grand Health Potion (GM), you feel like you could wrestle a goblin with one hand?

hermit.name: Misty Hermit
hermit.description: An old gardener picking glowing herbs in the mist.
dialogue: The herbs here make the finest Health Potions in the realm. The guard loves them for his sore joints!

goblin.name: Nasty Goblin
goblin.description: A twitchy green creature clutching a rusty dagger.
dialogue: Grah! Give me your shiny potions or I will bite your ankles!
You think you tough because you tall? Short goblins strike knee level first!
Hey! That's my shiny dagger! Drop it or face my pointy stick!

goblin_chief.name: Goblin Chief
goblin_chief.description: A bulkier goblin wearing a helmet made from an old cooking pot.
dialogue: I am Chief of Forest! No tall humans allowed without paying potion tax!

boss_dragon.name: Cave Dragon
boss_dragon.description: A massive, scaly beast sleeping atop a pile of stolen shiny trinkets.
dialogue: WHO DARES DISTURB MY NAP?! Do you have any idea how hard it is to sleep on pointy amulets and dragon horns?!
ROAR! I will roast you like a marshmallow on a stick!
Another 'hero'? Great, more crunchy armor to pick out of my teeth...

book_dagger.name: Dagger Mastery Book
book_dagger.description: A leather-bound manual detailing quick strikes and stealth assassination maneuvers.

book_sword.name: Sword Combat Manual
book_sword.description: An ancient tome describing heavy swings, parries, and knightly stances.

boss_horn.name: Dragon Horn
boss_horn.description: A razor-sharp horn severed from the Cave Dragon. It radiates intense heat.

dagger.name: Rogue Dagger
dagger.description: A swift, light blade perfect for sneaky critical strikes.

medals.name: Mayor's Medal of Honor
medals.description: A shiny gold medal awarded by the Mayor. It looks expensive, but is mostly painted cardboard.

potion_attack_PM.name: Petite Attack Potion
potion_attack_PM.description: A small vial of glowing red elixir that temporarily boosts your attack damage (+5 ATK).

potion_attack_GM.name: Grand Attack Potion
potion_attack_GM.description: A large flask of surging crimson brew that drastically empowers your strikes (+20 ATK).

potion_health_PM.name: Petite Health Potion
potion_health_PM.description: A small green potion that instantly restores 25 HP.

potion_health_GM.name: Grand Health Potion
potion_health_GM.description: A potent, bubbling green brew that fully restores up to 100 HP.

sword.name: Iron Sword
sword.description: A sturdy iron sword. Far better than throwing harsh words at a dragon.

herb.name: Healing Herb
herb.description: A glowing medicinal plant emitting a soothing peppermint aroma.

magic_amulet.name: Magic Amulet
magic_amulet.description: A glowing ancient amulet belonging to the Mayor. It hums with tacky magical energy.

fetch_herbs.title: Herb Gathering
fetch_herbs.description: Bring 1 Healing Herb from the Hidden Grove to the Village Guard.

fetch_amulet.title: The Mayor's Lost Amulet
fetch_amulet.description: Defeat the Cave Dragon in the Boss Lair and recover the Mayor's Magic Amulet.

scholar_research.title: Dragon Trophy Research
scholar_research.description: Bring the Dragon Horn from the Boss Lair to the Royal Scholar in the Library.
